newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Sol Melia assigned BBB plus by S&P.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Sol Melia assigned BBB plus by S&P.

text.p: U.S.-based rating agency Standard & Poor's said on Wednesday it had assigned a "BBB plus" rating to Spanish hotel chain Sol Melia.
In a statement S&P added that Sol Melia had a stable outlook, as it was expected to maintain a high level of profits and cash-flow given its steady market share in Spain.
The rating reflects the company's position as Spain's hotel chain, its focus on high margins and cash-generative management contracts, S&P said.
"Sol Melia's BBB plus rating is the highest current rating by Standard & Poor's to corporates wholly dedicated to the hotel business.
Limiting factors are the company's modest operations and cash flow to date, geographical concentration in Spain and family control, which constrains its financial flexibility.
